description: Find a school (university or high school) on Studocu by name, to get its id for search-courses. Show the user the name, type, and country, not the id. If several results are plausible, ask the user to pick.

limit.description: How many schools to return. Integer from 1 to 10. Default 3.

query.description: School name to search, 1-200 characters after trimming. Example: "University of Amsterdam".

type.description: Optional filter: UNIVERSITY or HIGH_SCHOOL. Omit to search both.

name: search-institutions
title: Search Institutions
